city_served.value: Okatie, SC is served — one of the 12 towns claimed on the site, all confirmed by Paul 2026-10-06.
city_served.source: Brand Guide E (all 12 towns confirmed, Paul 2026-10-06); decisions-settled 'business' (12 towns)

local_context.value: Unincorporated community stretching from south central Jasper County into western Beaufort County, named for the Okatee River (an estuary of Port Royal Sound); elevation 20 ft; predominantly low-density residential development since the 1990s, so housing is largely recent; the page gives estimated growth of 30.5% (27,703 in 2020 to 36,146 in July 2024) [figures as printed on the page; its infobox 2010 count of 12,570 is inconsistent, so treat population as indicative]. Bounded by I-95 and SC 462; SC 170 is the main route. Climate/hurricane not stated on page.

neighborhoods.value: 4 verified: Sun City Hilton Head (age-restricted planned community in the Okatie area of Beaufort and Jasper counties, unincorporated), Riverbend, Oldfield (Wikipedia; 'gated, on the Okatie River' only from non-official club pages), Callawassie Island (gated residential community, Okatie SC 29909, with its own published ARC Design Standards). Spring Island: Okatie only as a mailing address, its own site says Beaufort — 'Okatie-area' only (Apex works there, Paul 2026-10-12). Okatie is unincorporated and spans Beaufort and Jasper counties; fewer than 6 found (target).

things_to_do.value: Hilton Head Island Recreation Association and the Beaufort-Jasper YMCA of the Lowcountry are listed on the page (fitness classes, youth programs). No attractions otherwise stated; thin.

top_sites.value: Altamaha Town Heritage Preserve (county passive park, about 100 acres of oak-hickory forest along the Okatie and Colleton Rivers off Old Bailey's Road near SC 170; NRHP 1994; 0.5-mile earthen trail); Callawassie Island Sugar Works (tabby ruins, 'the only sugar mill ruins known to exist in South Carolina' — on gated Callawassie Island, not a place to visit); Old Barrel Landing School (one-room school on SC 170, restored 1995 — weak source, SC Picture Project).
